name: ai-exam-coach
description: MERN + Gemini 2.5 Flash exam preparation platform. Upload a recruitment notification PDF, get a syllabus, lessons, adaptive quizzes, mock tests, a 60-day roadmap and an AI mentor.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
